units.function: HTTP regression tests for validating selected execution-environment driver/provider types when project policies or issue workspace settings are created or updated.
units.dependencyDirection: Supertest/Vitest -> project and issue routes -> mocked environment/project/issue/company/Secret/reference/activity services; no access-policy engine, database, Connector runtime or node registry is exercised.
units.keyDataModels: Project executionWorkspacePolicy, issue executionWorkspaceSettings, environment ID/company/driver/provider and implicit board actor.
units.lifecycle: Receive project/issue mutation -> load selected environment -> allow recognized sandbox/plugin provider or reject unsupported/internal fake driver -> persist project/issue settings through mocked service.
units.testAssessment: Approved unsandboxed focused Vitest passed 7/7. It provides narrow regression coverage for allowed driver names but does not prove exact success status, tenant grants, actor authority, environment readiness, capability/data/Secret compatibility, revalidation, concurrency or structured policy evidence.
units.designRationale: Prevent user-visible project/issue configuration from persisting environment types that the run path cannot execute, while allowing plugin-backed sandbox providers.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS must decide whether a specific human/Agent Work may use a particular tenant-granted execution profile with defined capabilities, Secrets, data scope, risk and accountable owner.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT as an ExecutionProfileAuthorization decision: bind tenant/deployment grant, actor and accountable human, Work/project, Connector capabilities/version, environment health, Secret/data contracts, risk/approval and policy digest. Persist structured allow/deny evidence and revalidate immutable inputs at Run admission.
units.responsibilityConflict: Driver acceptance says nothing about who is responsible, which data/tools may leave the company, who approved elevated actions or whether the environment remains authorized at execution time. It cannot support the Company OS responsibility chain.
units.securityFindings: CRITICAL authorization-model gap: selection is driver/provider validation without tenant grant, actor, Work, data, Secret, risk or approval binding. HIGH readiness gap: status/plugin health/capability/version and runtime attestation are untested. HIGH TOCTOU gap: no execution-time revalidation after environment mutation/deletion. MEDIUM test weakness: accepted cases only assert not-422 and rejections depend on English strings.
